links.outcome: Generalizability of language model to different sites after site-specific fine-tuning
links.effect: Fine-tuning showed potential for increasing generalizability to different sites; no numeric results given in the abstract.
links.quote: We additionally demonstrate the benefits of pretraining with clinical text, the potential for increasing generalizability to different sites through fine-tuning and the full deployment of our system in a prospective, single-arm trial.

unlisted_practices: Pretraining language models on clinical text from the health system's own notes

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates NYUTron (an LLM-based predictive engine) across five clinical/operational tasks, including a prospective real-world deployment trial, but focuses on model performance rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
